chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from al-Abbas ibn Musa al-Warraq from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hafs ibn al-Bakhtari from Isḥaq ibn 'Ammar

Regarding a man who wants to marry a woman who has been divorced three times, how should he act? He said: 'He waits for her until she becomes pure (from her menstrual period). Then he comes to her husband, accompanied by two men, and says: 'You have divorced so-and-so.' When he says: 'Yes,' he says: 'He left her for three months, then he proposed to her directly (for the third divorce).'
ai.seo_question: What is the procedure for a man to marry a woman who has been divorced three times in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith details the specific ritual of 'Tanzil' (or 'Iqra') where the first husband remarries the woman to lift the barrier of three divorces, a prerequisite for her to return to him. It highlights the Shia emphasis on the husband's explicit declaration of the three-month waiting period before proposing, ensuring the validity of the intermediate marriage. This procedure is crucial in Shia jurisprudence for distinguishing between a simple remarriage and the restoration of the original marital bond after a triple talaq.
